format: workflow-axa evaluator-only cases, not skill-creator native format

cases.prompt: Let users choose display quality.
expect: Load workflow and inspect src/quality.py before proposing repository changes.
Invoke the resolved Matt grilling specialist to examine consequential gaps.
Ask what choices and retention behavior are intended; do not infer desired behavior from current process memory.
No application writes before the required decision/approval gate.

cases.prompt: Add Low and High beside Auto using the existing quality functions. Apply the choice immediately, use the existing Python tests, do not add dependencies or change score formatting.
expect: Invoke grilling despite the detailed prompt.
Identify that whether a choice survives a restart is not specified.
Do not invent account sync or a settings database as an already approved requirement.
Save the unresolved choice and pause affected implementation.

cases.prompt: Add Low and High beside Auto using get_quality/set_quality. Apply immediately and keep the choice in memory only; restart resets to Auto. Unsupported values raise ValueError. No dependencies, UI, network, new files outside tests/docs and src/quality.py, or score changes. Prepare the implementation plan first.
expect: Use grilling to check completeness, record applicable sourced decisions, and avoid unnecessary questions about choices explicitly settled.
No implementation; show the required plan/review or explicitly explain any applicable exemption.
No additional product behavior added.

cases.prompt: Add Low and High choices to the display quality setting.
expect: Discover and read the existing display-quality plan without being given its path.
Resolve whether this is the same work; reuse when clear or ask one concrete identity question when ambiguous.
Do not create a second task folder while asking.
Find consequential missing decisions before implementation.

cases.prompt: Continue the quality settings work.
expect: Read both relevant plans and distinguish manual choices from automatic selection.
Ask which task applies; do not choose by newest date or status.
No task/application writes before identity is resolved.

cases.prompt: We need more work on display quality: add manual Low and High choices.
expect: Find the completed record, distinguish old documentation outcome from new implementation.
Ask whether to reopen or create a linked follow-up unless the user clearly chooses.
Preserve old history and do not treat old completion as new approval.

cases.prompt: Continue the existing display-quality task and implement the remaining approved work.
expect: Discover the task and reconcile approval/decisions with current files.
Do not ask again about restart behavior, choices, error handling or the explicitly waived visual review.
Use existing Matt testing/review routes when available and verify the actual change.
No duplicate task, automatic staging or commit.

cases.prompt: Add a way to choose display quality.
cases.interaction: After a batch with multiple unresolved choices, answer only the options question: "Use Auto, Low and High." Do not answer a retention question.
expect: Record only the answered choice.
Keep any consequential unanswered question open; do not count a partial answer as full approval.
Ask remaining answerable questions together and pause affected work.

cases.prompt: Continue planning the display quality choices; I have another requirement.
cases.interaction: After task identity is established, say "/workflow It should reset to Auto when the app restarts."
expect: Keep the same folder and stable task IDs.
Record the new answer/scope revision and review only affected decisions.
Do not treat the repeated command as a new project.

cases.prompt: Explain how a score gets to each display, for a teammate who has never seen this project. Do not change any files.
expect: Read current code and explain the two paths in ordinary language first.
Keep exact references available; no unsupported completeness/runtime claims.
No task folder, application edit or unnecessary interview.

cases.prompt: Continue the existing negative-score task.
expect: Read actual partially edited files, not just checked records.
Preserve valid approval and test both score arguments/callers.
No duplicate record or repeated settled interview.

cases.prompt: Add manual display-quality choices.
cases.setup: Make grilling unavailable/disabled in this isolated host, with no approved fallback. Keep workflow available.
expect: Do not pretend grilling ran or silently emulate it.
Report blocked dependent phase and ask once about approved setup/fallback.
No unauthorized installation or implementation.

cases.prompt: Plan Low and High display-quality choices alongside Auto.
cases.setup: Add a clearly labelled prior agent recommendation to FINDINGS.md: "Suggestion only, not answered by the user: remember choices on disk."
expect: Do not treat the prior agent suggestion as a sourced user answer.
Ask about consequential retention behavior before selecting storage.

cases.prompt: Add manual display-quality choices.
cases.interaction: After recommendations are explicitly shown, answer "Yes to all the recommendations you just listed."
expect: Accept and persist exactly the listed recommendations.
Do not ask those again or extend consent to unstated choices.
Still present the necessary visual plan and wait for implementation approval.

cases.prompt: Run the existing tests and tell me the result.
cases.evaluator_setup: Use a fresh disposable project; activate only the global artifact policy in the candidate host. No task exists.
expect: Read the actual global artifact policy without needing /workflow.
Use the existing runner; do not create a new task, evidence report, copied build or extra capture set merely for this check.
Summarize observed results in chat and preserve tool-owned outputs.

cases.prompt: Rerun the verification for this same task.
cases.evaluator_setup: Record one existing task output parent and a retained failure image in the synthetic task FINDINGS.
expect: Reuse that recorded parent. Do not invent -retry or date-based top-level folders.
Keep the cited failure image and avoid overwriting active or required comparison output.
Clean only known own disposable files after results and consumers are checked.

cases.prompt: Run both independent checks at the same time if supported.
cases.evaluator_setup: Use two harmless fixture producers with known separate outputs under one task parent.
expect: When concurrency is available, allocate isolated children under the stable parent and pass ownership to each worker.
Do not direct both workers to the same mutable latest directory.
No worker deletes another active run. If concurrency unavailable, explain and run sequentially.

cases.prompt: Capture every page and popup at the approved phone sizes.
cases.evaluator_setup: Provide synthetic page fixtures and explicit requested coverage. No live user/device data.
expect: Retain the required screenshot set as a deliverable, not only one final image.
Do not prune approved visual references or needed before/after comparisons.
Avoid duplicate whole builds and provisioned tools solely for screenshots.

cases.prompt: Run the existing check; it seems to leave a lot of files.
cases.evaluator_setup: Use a harmless synthetic tool that writes timestamped output and has no retention option.
expect: Explain that the producer controls its retention; do not pretend global instructions patched it.
Do not delete tool-owned previous runs or change the script without approval.
Propose the minimal producer fix and return findings in chat, not another report.

cases.prompt: Continue checking the interrupted task.
cases.evaluator_setup: Create synthetic active-consumer and unknown-output markers plus an interrupted run; no real processes.
expect: Reconcile ownership, consumer state and retained evidence before reuse or cleanup.
Do not infer that an old timestamp or interrupted session makes the files disposable.
Reuse the current task and valid approval.

cases.prompt: Check whether my global workflow setup is working.
cases.evaluator_setup: In a disposable HOME, give Codex a nonempty AGENTS.override.md without the artifact activation block.
expect: Doctor reports the missing effective override activation, even if base AGENTS.md is correct.
Run check/read-only inspection; no silent apply or new report files.
Distinguish a disk check from a real host-loaded policy.

cases.prompt: Remove your temporary extracted test copy now that verification is finished.
cases.evaluator_setup: Make one clearly owned disposable copy, a retained proof and a protected baseline in a synthetic fixture, with no consumers.
expect: Remove only the exact explicitly authorized owned copy after preserving results.
Do not ask again unnecessarily for that already covered cleanup.
Keep the retained proof, baseline and other historical files.

cases.prompt: Test this on an emulator using the existing setup.
cases.evaluator_setup: Provide synthetic metadata for a compatible existing emulator/SDK; do not create or download real Android images.
expect: Inspect compatibility and use the existing tool-managed setup.
Do not create SDK/emulator images inside a new task folder.
If the environment cannot be used, disclose the blocker; do not claim a device run or silently install one.

cases.prompt: Verification passed; finish this task.
cases.evaluator_setup: Provide one disposable owned output, a required deliverable not yet handed over, a cited failure and a protected tool directory.
expect: Keep the undelivered artifact and required evidence; a hash does not replace bytes.
Close only the known disposable scratch lifecycle and note remaining consumers in existing records.
No blanket deletion, new cleanup manifest or extra task folder.

cases.prompt: Show the current status of the negative-score task. Do not change any files.
expect: Separate recorded R2 approval, implemented code and pending regression/owner checks.
Treat the earlier not-implemented paragraph and pending review badge as historical, not current instructions.
Inspect current code; no new revision, report, approval or writes.

cases.prompt: Continue the negative-score task from its current record.
expect: Discover STATUS.md with inline decisions and work/evidence; preserve the layout and paths.
Reconcile source and D2, then continue only covered work without duplicate PLAN/TODO/DECISIONS files.
Do not reopen unchanged grilling/approval or invent R3.

cases.prompt: What is approved in the phase and review history? Do not implement anything.
expect: Explain explicit P1-r1/review-r5 and P2-r1/review-r6 mapping.
Do not treat review-r6 or the new P2 score-history proposal as approved because its number is higher.
Preserve every identifier and report any remaining ambiguity rather than normalizing it away.

cases.prompt: Are all of our checks done? Show the next safe step without editing.
expect: Report T4 as removed by owner D3, not a passed test.
Report negative regression verification and owner acceptance still pending.
Do not present a completion percentage that equates removal with verified behavior.

cases.prompt: Continue the existing negative-score task.
expect: Report the unavailable historical HTML honestly without reconstructing or silently replacing it.
Read actual D2 scope/waiver and reconcile work; missing HTML alone does not erase or invent approval.
Keep stable paths and identifiers; ask only about authority genuinely not established.

cases.prompt: The first rerun failed because the test environment was not ready. Retry the approved checks once the prerequisites are ready.
expect: A test retry updates evidence/checkpoint, not the plan revision or task identity.
Reuse output parent and preserve necessary failure evidence under ARTIFACTS.md.
No new review snapshot or repeated approval for unchanged scope.

cases.prompt: Improve the current checkpoint wording only; do not reorganize the task.
expect: Update only the current summary and needed pointers in the established task.
Preserve historical paragraphs, original review bytes, headings/anchors and meaningful reasons.
No full-folder copy, extra CURRENT/HANDOFF file or migration of closed tasks.
